answer.origin: Primary source: NVIDIA Corporation Form 8-K filed on SEC EDGAR, report date August 17, 2026, covering Item 1.01 (material definitive agreement), Item 2.03 (direct financial obligation) and Item 7.01 (Regulation FD press release, Exhibit 99.1). The company's own statement; event and publication date both August 17, 2026.
answer.note: Source claim: NVIDIA entered into multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy as Lessor on August 17, 2026, relating to leases for approximately 4.25 GW of IT load at the Portsmouth Site (PORTS Technology Campus, Pike County, Ohio). An affiliate of OpenAI Group PBC is the tenant. NVIDIA's aggregate payment obligation under its initial commitment is cumulatively capped at $105 billion. An Agreement generally becomes effective on commencement of the applicable lease. NVIDIA may also provide credit support for an additional approximately 3.8 GW at its sole discretion. Payment obligations are conditional on the Lessor satisfying ready-for-service conditions, expected beginning in 2028. On a Trigger Event (OpenAI insolvency causing lease default, or OpenAI payment failure), NVIDIA pays generally the shortfall between a guaranteed minimum lease value and amounts recovered via replacement lease or sale. OpenAI agreed to reimburse NVIDIA for amounts actually paid. The source states OpenAI will use capacity supporting the 4.25 GW to deploy NVIDIA's full-stack DSX AI factory platform, subject to limited exceptions. What it supports: NVIDIA has taken on a large, contingent credit-support exposure for an AI data center campus whose tenant is OpenAI, with the cap and the 4.25 GW figure as the disclosed scale. Conditional interpretation: if the guaranties are called, NVIDIA's exposure is driven by OpenAI's credit or payment performance and by delivery of the Lessor's premises from 2028; the $105 billion figure is a ceiling on the initial commitment, not an expected cash outflow. The 4.25 GW figure is IT load, not contracted power or revenue, and the source gives no revenue, margin or accounting amount for NVIDIA. The DSX deployment statement is a company-stated expectation and does not establish NVIDIA hardware orders or revenue from this site.
limitations: The full text of the Agreements is not in the source; the form will be filed as an exhibit to the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026. Guaranteed minimum values, shortfall formulas, and other economic terms are therefore not known.
Lease commencement dates for the 4.25 GW are not disclosed; no statement says whether any lease has commenced, so effectiveness of the guaranties is not established.
The $105 billion cap applies to the initial commitment only; the amount of the optional additional approximately 3.8 GW credit support and its cap are not disclosed.
The source gives no expected probability, fair value, accounting liability or recognition treatment for the guaranties in NVIDIA's financial statements.
Whether NVIDIA's DSX platform sales to OpenAI or the Portsmouth Site would generate NVIDIA revenue, and in what amount, is not stated; the source describes deployment, not purchase orders.
The 2028 ready-for-service timing is a company expectation in forward-looking statements, and the source gives no construction, power or shell schedule supporting it.
OpenAI's credit standing, payment history and any affiliate-level financial information are not in the source, so the likelihood of a Trigger Event cannot be assessed from this record alone.
The SB Energy financing structure beyond the Lessor role, including any other lenders or equity holders, is not described.
follow_up: When the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 26, 2026 is filed, check the exhibit containing the Agreement text for guaranteed minimum values, cap structure, Trigger Event definitions and termination terms.
Check the 10-Q and subsequent annual filing for any recognized guarantee liability, fair value disclosure or commitment note relating to the SB Energy Agreements.
Check the Exhibit 99.1 press release and subsequent SB Energy or OpenAI announcements for lease commencement dates and confirmation of the ready-for-service schedule.
Check later NVIDIA filings for any disclosed revenue, orders or backlog linked to the Portsmouth Site or to OpenAI deployment of DSX.
Check whether any Trigger Event, lease default or replacement lease has been reported for the Portsmouth Site.
